text: BlockSure: A Decentralized Blockchain Platform for Secure and Trustworthy Transactions presents the following source proposition: Transaction services built on the blockchain provide a revolutionary means of boosting security and trust in online transactions. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that A truly decentralized public blockchain must satisfy three simultaneous requirements: no points of centralization and corruption, full security at the level of proof of work, and transaction throughput above one hundred thousand transactions per second.
